name: Trade Partners
description: Shows the trade the game runs behind your markets: the 8 partner nations, what each brings to or takes from the market every day (after tension and lost trade ships), what is blocked and why, stock and storage limits, buy/sell prices and each market's price multipliers. Britain can switch between the colony and England markets. Open it from the PARTNERS tab on the market screen or with F6. Read-only: changes nothing in the game.
author: UGAR modding project
